subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should Teams Graph media fallback be default-on for channel/group HTML stubs, config-gated behind channels.msteams.graphMediaFallback, or split into separate channel and group-chat fixes?
rationale: Current source proves the bug, but the safe product behavior depends on accepting extra Graph lookups by default versus adding new config surface and requiring operators to opt in.

options.title: Use the channel fix as canonical
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738 or an equivalent fix for the original channel root causes, then handle the group-chat config gate separately if desired.

options.title: Require a combined config-gated fix
options.body: Ask for one PR that combines the channel URL corrections with the default-off graphMediaFallback option and docs.

options.title: Pause for fallback policy review
options.body: Keep both PRs open until a Teams owner decides whether ordinary channel/group HTML stubs may trigger Graph lookups by default.

recommendation.title: Use the channel fix as canonical
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738 or an equivalent fix for the original channel root causes, then handle the group-chat config gate separately if desired.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about plugin-boundary and config/fallback policy, and steipete has the strongest visible history across the Teams plugin boundary and security-sensitive media paths.
